description: (0.5.0, Draft) derived_from comes from the arguments only, in JCS traversal order, deduplicated (RFC-ACDP-0019 §4.4).

input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

expected.behavior: For the mcp-001 arguments, derived_from is the two distinct ctx_ids in JCS preorder (keys sorted per RFC 8785 §3.2.3, arrays in index order), first occurrence kept.
Object keys, acdp:// strings embedded inside longer text, upper-case authorities and non-v4 UUIDs are not extracted.
ctx_ids appearing only in the result are not added to derived_from.
Extraction stops after 1000 entries (the RFC-ACDP-0002 derived_from maximum).
